# upsnap Provider

Manage [UpSnap](https://github.com/seriousm4x/UpSnap) wake-on-LAN dashboards through their PocketBase API.

Authenticate either with `username` and `password` (a PocketBase superuser by default, or an UpSnap user with `auth_collection = "users"`) or with a `token`. Ports, users, permissions and settings can only be managed by a superuser.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    upsnap = {
      source = "windkube/upsnap"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials can also come from UPSNAP_ENDPOINT, UPSNAP_USERNAME and UPSNAP_PASSWORD (or UPSNAP_TOKEN).
provider "upsnap" {
  endpoint = "http://upsnap.lan:8090"
  username = "admin@example.com"
  password = var.upsnap_password
}

variable "upsnap_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_collection` (String) Collection `username` authenticates against: `_superusers` (default) or `users`. Can also be set with `UPSNAP_AUTH_COLLECTION`.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of UpSnap, for example `http://upsnap.lan:8090`. Can also be set with `UPSNAP_ENDPOINT`.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Can also be set with `UPSNAP_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for `username`. Can also be set with `UPSNAP_PASSWORD`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) PocketBase auth token, for example a superuser impersonation token. Refreshable tokens are refreshed before they expire. Can also be set with `UPSNAP_TOKEN`.
- `username` (String) Superuser email or UpSnap username/email. Can also be set with `UPSNAP_USERNAME`.
